newsitem.title: GERMANY: Nine hurt in foreigners' home fire - German police.
newsitem.headline: Nine hurt in foreigners' home fire - German police.

text.p: Nine people were injured in a blaze in an apartment complex mainly occupied by foreigners in the western town of Kassel, German police said on Saturday.
Police said they were not ruling out the possibility that the fire, which broke out in the early hours of Saturday, could have been the result of a racist attack.
They said a witness reported seeing an unknown young man throwing a brick-sized object into one apartment in the complex just before the fire broke out shortly after midnight.

The witness said after the missile was thrown into the building he heard an explosion and then saw flames coming out of the window. Police said all the inhabitants were rescued and those injured suffered from smoke inhalation.
